hotspot_events.heat_reason: First-hand notification on USTR official website confirms that tariff and ocean freight cliff on 11-09/11-10 is relieved, but extended by only two months, impacting core BOM import costs
hotspot_events.summary: On 11-06, USTR published two notices on its official website: all 178 existing Section 301 exclusions (164 general + 14 solar manufacturing equipment) are extended to 2027-01-09 23:59 (EST), applicable to goods entered for consumption or withdrawn from warehouse on or after 2026-11-10 00:01; Maritime Section 301 actions (including shipping fees and Annex V.A ship-to-shore crane equipment tariffs) are simultaneously suspended from 2026-11-09 through the same date. However, it is extended by only two months, with the next expiration on 2027-01-09; Federal Register publication has not yet been confirmed.
hotspot_events.title: USTR Issues Two Notices on 11-06: 178 Section 301 Exclusions and Maritime Fee Suspensions Both Extended to 2027-01-09
